description: Proof-of-existence: hash the document LOCALLY (sha256, 64 hex) and send only the hash. The issuer countersigns {h, ts} with ML-DSA-65 (post-quantum); ts is SERVER-assigned. Optional owner endorsement: ownerAddr + ownerSig = EIP-191 over "null-notary/owner/v1|<h>"; if you add ownerMeta and that identity publishes a PQ key, ownerSig2 (ML-DSA over the same string) is REQUIRED. Proves existence-by-time (+ endorsement), never authorship or uniqueness. Verify with null_prov_issuer (pin the key) + SDK notaryVerify. Private-lane-only: use the stdio door.

h.description: sha256 of the document, 64 lowercase hex - NEVER the content

ownerSig2.description: base64 ML-DSA-65 over null-notary/owner/v1|<h> by the published identity key

name: null_notarize
title: NULL Notary - prove a document existed, without revealing it (lane)
